text.en:
FOODSTUFF (LOCAL)
Wholesaler's
Roasted Ground Coffee,
Loenlly Prepared with
Imported Coffee Boons
Packed in Paper Bags:
Cafe Ixcclente
The ceiling prices fixed in this Order
include for Libby's Evaporated Nilk products the 7%
Sales Tor and 1% Municipal Tax and för Cafe Excelente
the 76 Sales Tax.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the vity of Monilo, this 11th day of July,
in the yer of Lur Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
(SGD.) ILPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SAD. ) MARCIAITO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
7-13-52
